title: Investment Fixture F-03
audience: first-time long-term investors comparing transparent managed portfolios
existing self-directed investors evaluating fees, risk, and methodology
pageJob: Explain a fictional regulated investment platform's eligibility, fees, risk method, and data boundaries before inviting a visitor to check eligibility.

facts.statement: The fictional service has a minimum initial investment of GBP 2,500.
The platform fee is a fictional 0.48% per year, excluding underlying fund costs of 0.12% to 0.24%.
Five fictional globally diversified portfolios are mapped to risk bands rather than return targets.
Portfolio weights are reviewed quarterly and rebalanced when a declared tolerance is exceeded.
Any example chart must be labelled illustrative and generated from benchmark-authored fictional data.
Capital is at risk and eligibility is not a recommendation or guarantee of suitability.

requiredContent: minimum investment and complete fee layers
quarterly review and tolerance-based rebalance explanation
source label on every illustrative data view
constraints: Do not invent returns, customer counts, regulator names, security certifications, or guaranteed outcomes.
Do not use neon-fintech visuals as a substitute for understandable numbers.
Eligibility must not be described as regulated advice or a suitability decision.
Data visualizations require text alternatives and visible units.

assetPolicy.instruction: Use benchmark-authored CSS and fact-derived illustrative data only; no market data, logos, screenshots, portraits, or financial charts are supplied.

shippingBudgets.accessibilityTarget: WCAG 2.2 AA practical floor; conformance requires complete evidence
